question: Does a contact-requiring objective break the v0.0.11 zero-contact passive equilibrium (0 contact ticks in 876 games)?
classification: diagnostic self-play; AGENTS.md boxing gates remain unmet; no claim of boxing competence

rules.anti_stalling: grokbot.endings.anti_stalling: a result reached with no landed strike by either corner before the ending tick and no points is a no contest (no utility, return 0)
rules.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(anti_stalling=True); the jekko BoxingEnv and referee are unchanged

reset.label: grokbot-range-0.80m-v0
reset.mechanism: BoxingEnv's own reset-only root pelvis_tx shift along each athlete's facing direction; nothing else changes

measurements_before_training: native keyframe athletes fall backward (heads ~1.3 m away from the opponent within 1.2 s); no contact at 1.0/0.8/0.6 m for gen4, baseline, relaxed/cocontract, noise
v0.0.11 checkpoints gen0..gen6 re-evaluated at 0.80 m under anti-stalling: engagement share and gate decision reported before any v0.0.12 training

training.learner: grokbot.selfplay antithetic ES with common random numbers, P4 opponent sampler
training.shaping: training-only approach term: (initial - closest own-hand-to-opponent head/trunk distance) / initial, weight 0.5; never used for evaluation, gating or Elo

evaluation.opponents: every earlier checkpoint of this run plus the scripted panel
evaluation.paired_samples: side-swapped pairs sharing a seed count once

gates.engagement_gate: a candidate must land a strike in >= 0.25 of its evaluation bouts (GateConfig.min_engaged_share = 0.25)
gates.promotion: grokbot.promotion.decide against the champion with min_valid = 6 paired samples, all other checks at defaults
gates.no_contest_handling: no-contest bouts are excluded from the broken-game invalid share; they count against engagement

success_criterion: v0.0.12 is a level-up iff at least one generation is promoted under the engagement gate. Elo gains without engagement do not count.
pre_declared_failure_reading: if no generation reaches the engagement gate, the result is reported as 'passive equilibrium not broken by objective change alone'; the next lever is motor capability (forward lean / reach primitive or the pretrained bridge), not more rule tuning
limitations: linear 140-parameter region policy; no opponent observations
strikes are classified contacts (approach and active speed >= 0.5 m/s), not qualified referee points
0.80 m reset is a grokbot candidate variant, not a jekko-registered scenario
